features.title: Create a note
features.behavior: `notes add <title>` creates a markdown file under data/notes/ and prints its path.

features.title: List notes
features.behavior: `notes list` prints one line per stored note: id, title, modified date.
features.notes: Sorting by modified date not implemented yet; listing works.

features.title: Search notes
features.behavior: `notes search <term>` prints matching notes with the matching line quoted.
